content: संदिश् €6 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To give, grant, assign, make over; राज्यं संदिश्य भोगांश्च ममार व्रणपीडितः <ls>Bk. 6. 141</ls>; <ls>Y. 2. 232</ls>. .²2 To order, direct, instruct, advise, send as a message; किं नु खलु दुष्यन्तस्य युक्तरूपमस्माभिः संदेष्टव्यम् <ls>Ś. 4</ls>; <ls>Śi. 9. 56</ls>, <ls n="Śi. 9.">61</ls>. .²3 To send as a messenger, entrust with a message; अथ विश्वात्मने गौरी संदिदेश मिथः सखीम् <ls>Ku. 6. 1</ls>. .²4 To appoint. .²5 To commission or depute in general.
